svg.aria-label: DUAL-REVIEW: Two models review every change. Both approve, or nothing ships. RELEASE-PILOT: Reads the merged PRs. Rules give GO or HOLD; a model writes the notes. TIX + RIG: Tickets in one house format. One health check for the whole setup. LOCAL MCP: Image generation, documents and memory search, on my machine
